about: The 60 identity design cases of ADR 0016, recovered on 2026-10-12 by replaying the 2026-10-05/06 throwaway script (suite.py) from the session record. Entities, cases and each case's outcome under rule set R2 (the decision). Case titles are the original Vietnamese. Also the R2 rule set (rules_r2), the ablations (each rule element removed, and the cases that get worse) and the additions (a changeable attribute added as a veto, and the cases it breaks). Input for the identity case fixtures of feature 002; not maintained. Emails were moved from the original domain to the reserved .example domain (RFC 2606); nothing else was changed.
